Cooldowns start the moment you click Mark Spawned and run for the standard 2‑hour Eureka NM cooldown. This tracker only knows what you tell it — it isn't connected to your game instance, so sync it with your party/shout calls the same way you would with ffxiv-eureka.com. Weather is calculated live from Eorzea time using the same forecast algorithm the game uses, so it should always match what you see in‑zone.
Your spawn timers are saved to this browser only.
